newsitem.title: USA: Elan's Diastat gets FDA approvable letter.
newsitem.headline: Elan's Diastat gets FDA approvable letter.

text.p: Elan Corp Plc said on Wednesday that its Athena Neurosciences Inc unit has received an approvable letter from the Food and Drug Administration for its Diastat rectal gel to treat epilepsy.
Diastat is a gel formulation of diazepam and is approvable for rectal administration for patients who require intermittent use of diazepam to control bouts of increased seizure activity, Elan said.
The conditions for approval include reaching an agreement on labeling proposed by the FDA, guidance for the use of Diastat and submission of a current safety update, Elan said.

Elan said the FDA has previously granted orphan drug status for Diastat, providing seven years of marketing exclusivity from new drug approval for an indication previously defined as acute repetitive seizures.
Elan plans to review the indication language proposed by the FDA to retain the company's orphan drug designation, it said.
